dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what are you listening to?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ər juː ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My favorite band. This is their new album.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈbænd. ðɪs ɪz ðɛr ˈnuː ˈælbəm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Can I listen? Oh, this song makes me happy!
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈlɪsən? ˈoʊ, ðɪs ˈsɔːŋ ˈmeɪks miː ˈhæpi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too. And the singer is amazing.
dialogue.reading: miː ˈtuː. ənd ðə ˈsɪŋər ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A summer trip to the beach. They make me excited about our trip!
dialogue.reading: ə ˈsʌmər ˈtrɪp tə ðə ˈbiːtʃ. ðeɪ ˈmeɪk miː ɪkˈsaɪtɪd əˈbaʊt aʊər ˈtrɪp!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I like sad songs. They make me calm.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈsæd ˈsɔːŋz. ðeɪ ˈmeɪk miː ˈkɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Sad songs make me sleepy!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈsæd ˈsɔːŋz ˈmeɪk miː ˈsliːpi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let's make a playlist for the trip. Six hours in a car will make us bored.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈmeɪk ə ˈpleɪlɪst fər ðə ˈtrɪp. ˈsɪks ˈaʊərz ɪn ə ˈkɑːr wɪl ˈmeɪk ʌs ˈbɔːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea! But no sad songs, OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! bʌt ˈnoʊ ˈsæd ˈsɔːŋz, oʊˈkeɪ?
